Subject: Redwood marketplace listing — procurement intake

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — team at Helix is keen to get Redwood listed in our procurement catalog. Procurement asked me to confirm:

- What exact paperwork do you need so we can route a Purchase Order? (PO format, billing entity, remittance address)
- Do you have a preferred invoice cadence and billing contact for marketplace sales?
- We’ll need SOC 2 evidence and insurance certificates for vendor intake — can you send the redacted SOC summary and policy links?
- Any required forms (W-9 / tax form equivalent) or legal contacts for MSA review?

If useful, we can set a 30-minute call with our procurement and legal on Monday. We’d like to map the PO lane and expected SLA for activation.

Attachment: None yet — waiting on Redwood checklist.

Thanks,
Megan Ortiz

Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace listing — procurement intake

Hi Megan — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise intake checklist and the immediate next steps to get Helix live on the Redwood Marketplace.

1) Required intake docs (attached):
   - Redwood vendor intake form (redwood-vendor-intake-form.pdf) — fill & return
   - W-9 / tax paperwork or equivalent for your billing entity (we mark required in the intake form)
   - Banking template for invoice remittance (vendor-banking-template.xlsx) — optional until PO issuance

2) Compliance evidence:
   - Attached: Redwood SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf) 
   - We can share full SOC 2 report under NDA — let us know the procurement secure portal for upload.

3) PO & billing lane:
   - Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. — we’ll provide the exact remittance address on the intake form.
   - Invoice cadence: Net 30 by default. If Helix requires Net 45 / Net 60 we can follow up with Finance but please flag early.
   - PO number field and invoice routing: please include PO# on the invoice PDF and send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com.

4) Legal / MSA:
   - We have a marketplace MSA and an addendum for marketplace listing. Small custom redlines are acceptable; for anything material, we’ll loop Legal.
   - If you’d like DocuSign, I can send the MSA via DocuSign after we confirm billing entity and contact.

Next steps:
- If you can complete the vendor intake form and return by end of week, Ben (copied) will validate banking/tax info.
- Please propose a 30-min slot if you want procurement + legal sync; otherwise we can coordinate asynchronously.

Attachments: redwood-vendor-intake-form.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf, vendor-banking-template.xlsx

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Rachel / Megan — quick clarifying notes from FinOps:

- Confirm billing entity: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (EIN will be provided on the intake form).
- Remittance address (US): 210 Market St, Suite 420, San Francisco, CA 94105 (we will also include on the PDF template).
- Invoices should reference the PO number and contain the seller email and billing contact. If Helix requires a different invoice format, share a sample and we’ll accommodate where possible.
- Currency: USD unless Helix requests local currency — that may affect pricing and tax handling.

Attachment: vendor-banking-template.xlsx
